title: 8-bit Bitwise XOR Gate
statement_md: Create a module named `bitwise_xor8` with two 8-bit inputs `a` and `b`, and one 8-bit output `y`. Each output bit must be the XOR of the corresponding input bits. This is combinational logic: the output must change whenever the inputs change.

tests.hint: Check that every output bit uses ^ (XOR), not | or +.
XOR with zero should pass the other operand through unchanged.
XOR of identical operands must be zero in every bit position.
Check that every output bit uses ^, not | or +.
Check which operator you used — addition carries information between bit positions, XOR must not.
Each output bit must depend only on the matching input bits, not neighboring bits.
The output must update whenever b changes, even if a stays the same — avoid an incomplete sensitivity list.
